notes.title: DEMO 1.2.3 Patch Notes
notes.content: [h2]Gameplay Changes[/h2][list][*][p]Secondary / Whistle now happens just by clicking \[Right Mouse Button]. No need to hold and select the Whistle.[/p][list][*][p]Also adds cooldown to Secondary[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Fixes Influenza A virus eventually killing Cells faster than it's supposed to.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Graphical Changes[/h2][list][*][p]New Hit particle[/p][/*][*][p]Blood Splatter randomization [/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: DEMO 1.2.2 Patch Notes
notes.content: [h3]Graphical Changes[/h3][list][*][p]New In-game HUD[/p][/*][*][p]New Blood splatter animation[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes some menu scaling and positioning issues in some resolutions[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: DEMO 1.2.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h2]BUGFIX[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixes Cell count eventual bug that caused game to never 'Game Over'
[/list]

[h2]GRAPHIC CHANGES[/h2]
[list]
[*] Introduces Trippy Fractal Effect during Fever Events
[/list]

notes.title: DEMO 1.2.0 - Platelets
notes.content:
[h2]UNITS[/h2]
[list]
[*] [h3](NEW) Platelet Cell[/h3]
[*] In [b]Level 03[/b] and [b]Endless Mode[/b], you can now spawn [b]Platelets[/b], which drop more money than Red Blood Cells but will consume baby Red Blood Cells periodically.
[*] [h3]Influenza A[/h3]
[*] Influenza A is now affected by the Ghosting Effect when killed. Which means they are imortal until the Gravestone is killed.
[/list]
[h2]UI[/h2]
[list]
[*] Small teaks to Paused game UI
[*] Removed Quit to Main Menu "X" Button in Skill Tree Menu and Stats Menu, replaced with the Return Button 
[/list]
[h2] Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixes bug that would soft-lock game when clicking rapidly on Endless Mode DNA upgrade selection
[*] Hopefully I fixed UltraWide (21:9) Resolution support and SteamDeck (16:10) Resolution support
[/list]

notes.content:

notes.title: DEMO 1.0.10 - HOTFIX
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixes sometimes cost of upgrade button still displaying as "???" after it has already changed to Normal State
[*] Fixes slight color difference from some upgrade buttons
[*] Fixes cost of upgrades being more expensive than they are supposed to
[/list]

notes.title: DEMO 1.0.9 PATCH NOTES
notes.content:
[list]
[h2][*] UI[/h2]
[*] You now need to hold New Game button for 5 seconds before wiping save, a warning message will also appear when attempting to wipe.
[*]In-game "shop" buttons have been separated into 4 states:
[b]Hidden[/b]: button wont show up at all;
[b]Secret[/b]: cost and name of purchase are marked as multiple question marks;
[b]Disabled[/b]: Names and Cost are available but clicking is disabled;
[b]Normal[/b]: Button is enabled
[*] Menus UI changed slightly
[/list]
[quote=author] As always, thanks for giving my silly game a try! [/quote]

notes.title: DEMO 1.0.8 PATCH NOTES
notes.content:
[list]
[h2][*] QoL / Accessibility[/h2]
[*] Cursor color is now customizable

[h2][*] Visual Changes [/h2]
[*] Adds new particles when Cursor gets stunned
[*] Adds Oxygen graphics
[*] Changes DNA Button outline

[h2][*] Gameplay Changes[/h2]
[*] Oxygen now floats instead of falling to bottom of screen

[h2][*] Bug Fixes [/h2]
[*] [Endless Mode] Fixes rare bug that caused power ups to not show up when clicking DNA button
[*] [Endless Mode] Fixes DNA button description incorrectly displaying Campaign Mode's description
[/list]

[quote=author] Thanks everyone for playing so far! [/quote]

notes.title: DEMO 1.0.7 PATCH NOTES
notes.content:
[list]
[h3][*] Visual Changes[/h3]
[*] White Blood Cell death particle animation
[*] Viruses that damage White Blood Cells on death now have a special death particle animation
[*] New Explosion particle animation
[*] Gravestone Hazard now has a particle animation when active
[*] Oxygen now increases in size, according to Oxygen Quality Upgrade purchases
[/list]

[list]
[h3][*] Bug Fixes[/h3]
[*] Skills with multiple attributes will no longer count as multiple Skill purchases when going back to DNA shop
[*] Rebinding keys will work now
[*] Virus Spawn is no longer doubled after a period of time
[*] Trade DMG for HP Skill now will properly divide the entire DMG output by 2, not just the base DMG value
[/list]

notes.title: DEMO 1.0.1 to DEMO 1.0.5
notes.content:
[h3]DEMO 1.0.1 PATCH NOTES:[/h3]
[list]
[*] FIXES Stats not tracking Cells Killed in Campaign and Endless Mode
[*] FIXES Stats not tracking Levels Reached in Endless Mode 
[*] FIXES Fever starting with 0 virus, causing the game to soft lock
[/list]

[list]
[*] CHANGES Oxygen Quality upgrade to no longer change the Red Blood Cells MAX. Stamina or Stamina Recovery

[/list]

[list]
[*] FIXES Unconscious Breathing not properly shortening spawn delay after every purchase
[*] FIXES Money Whistle not recovering money on screen
[/list]

[h3]DEMO 1.0.4 PATCH NOTES:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Rebalancing
[*] Dengue Drone now properly enters wandering state on Game Over
[/list]

[h3]DEMO 1.0.5 PATCH NOTES:[/h3]
[list]
[*] FIXES Volume Mixer going to 0 seemingly randomly
[*] FIXES "Kill 90% of Red Blood Cells for money" Power Up not working at all
[*] ADDS Cursor stun audio cue
[*] White Blood Cells will get knocked back when touching a explosion, instead of dying immediately

[/list]

Thanks everyone for playing so far!
